item.title: Gardaí Seize Two Uninsured Vehicles In Ennis
item.description: Gardaí have seized two uninsured vehicles in Ennis during patrols today. The Roads Policing Unit encountered a BMW 2 Series and later a Ford Focus Saloon on Francis Street, driving without valid policies. Both motorists will face court at a later date.
